## Context

Convert a markdown report (like PROJECT-RECAP.md, audit reports, migration reports) into a beautiful, self-contained HTML page. Unlike `/present-deck` (slide format), this produces a **document-style report** — scrollable, printable, with rich formatting.

This is a shared skill under @orch, available to any agent.

**Output formats:**
- `PROJECT-RECAP.md` → markdown (default, always produced by scan skills)
- `PROJECT-RECAP.html` → styled HTML report (this skill)
- Slide deck → use `/present-deck` instead

## Inputs

- `@orch /present-report from PROJECT-RECAP.md` — convert recap to HTML report
- `@orch /present-report from .orch/runs/2026-03-24/report.md` — convert any run report
- `@audit /present-report from audit-output.md` — convert audit report
- `--output report.html` — custom output filename (default: same name with .html)

## Steps

1. Read the source markdown file.
2. Read `.orch/config.yaml` for branding overrides (logo, colors, theme).
3. Parse markdown structure:
   - `# Title` → report header with overline + dateline
   - First paragraph or blockquote → executive summary box
   - Tables with numeric data → add progress bars where percentages found
   - Inline status markers (`[ok]`, `[warn]`, `[bad]`, `[info]`) → styled tags
   - `## Sections` → generate table of contents with anchor links
   - Code blocks → syntax-highlighted dark terminal style
   - Lists → styled with markers
4. Load design tokens from `deck-tokens.css` (shipped with ORCH, overridable).
5. Generate self-contained HTML:
   - All CSS inlined (no external dependencies)
   - Fonts loaded from Google Fonts CDN (or fallback to system fonts)
   - Print-friendly: `@media print` styles for clean PDF export
   - Responsive: readable on mobile
6. Apply branding:
   - Logo from `.orch/config.yaml` `presentation.logo_path` (if exists)
   - Colors from deck-tokens.css
   - Report footer: "Generated by ORCH • [agent] • [date] • [token count]"
7. Write the HTML file to the same directory as the source markdown.

## Output

Self-contained HTML file with:
- Report header (title, overline, date, branch)
- Executive summary (highlighted box)
- Stat strip (key metrics in a horizontal row)
- Table of contents (clickable anchors)
- Styled sections with: tables, progress bars, status tags, code blocks
- Prioritized recommendations (numbered, with skill references)
- Footer with generation metadata

## Post-Generation Verification (MANDATORY)

After generating the HTML report, run these checks. If any fail, fix and retry (max 3 attempts).

### Check 1: CSS & Styling
- Verify `deck-tokens.css` is linked with correct relative path
- Verify all CSS variables resolve (no `var(--undefined)` in output)
- Verify Google Fonts link is present
- Verify `.report-header`, `.exec-summary`, `.stat-strip`, `.section` classes are used

### Check 2: Mermaid Diagrams
- Verify NO HTML-breaking characters inside `<pre class="mermaid">` blocks:
  - No `<br/>` — use `\n` for line breaks in node labels
  - No `&lt;` `&gt;` — use text descriptions instead of angle brackets
  - No `&lpar;` `&rpar;` — use regular `(` `)` parentheses
  - No `&amp;` — use `and` or `+` instead
  - **CRITICAL: No TypeScript/Java generics syntax** like `Signal<Trade[]>` or `List<String>` — angle brackets are parsed as HTML tags and break rendering. Use `Signal(Trade[])` or `Signal of Trade` or wrap in double quotes: `["Signal<Trade[]>"]`
  - **CRITICAL: No unquoted special characters in node labels** — if a label contains `<`, `>`, `{`, `}`, `(`, `)`, or `|`, wrap the entire label in double quotes: `A["WritableSignal(Trade[])"]`
- Verify Mermaid `-->` arrows are not confused with HTML tags (they're valid Mermaid syntax)
- Verify Mermaid script tag exists before `</body>`
- Verify `mermaid.initialize()` has theme configuration matching report tokens
- Verify each diagram has a `<div class="diagram">` wrapper with `.diagram-title` and `.diagram-caption`

### Check 3: Structure
- HTML file opens without syntax errors (valid HTML)
- All sections from source markdown are present
- Tables have `<thead>` and `<tbody>` (no bare rows)
- Status tags use correct classes: `.tag-ok`, `.tag-warn`, `.tag-bad`, `.tag-info`
- TOC links (`<a href="#id">`) match section `id` attributes
- Footer with generation metadata is present

### Check 4: Content Quality
- Executive summary is concise (1-3 sentences)
- Stat strip has 4-6 key metrics (not more)
- Recommendations reference specific ORCH skills (`/angular-*`, `/audit-*`)
- No placeholder text (all `{{TEMPLATE}}` variables resolved)

### Retry Protocol
If any check fails:
1. Fix the specific issue
2. Re-run all 4 checks
3. Max 3 retry attempts
4. If still failing after 3 attempts, output the report with a warning header noting which checks failed

## Validation

- HTML file opens in any browser without errors
- All Mermaid diagrams render (no raw syntax visible)
- Tables render correctly (no broken layouts)
- Status tags display with correct colors
- TOC links navigate to correct sections
- Printable: `Cmd+P` produces clean PDF
- No external dependencies (works offline except fonts)
